text:
Oh, hello!
May I help you?
zh:
哦，你好！
有什么可以帮你的吗？

text: Do you trade knowledge?
zh: 你这里能交换知识吗？

text: The Arcanum Sanguis has been stolen.
zh: 血之秘典被偷了。

text: Where do the books come from?
zh: 这些书是从哪里来的？

text: What do you do?
zh: 你是做什么的？

text: Can you decipher this tome I found?
zh: 你能破译我找到的这本典籍吗？

text: Take this tome for your studies.
zh: 这本典籍你拿去研究吧。

text: Have you found out anything yet?
zh: 你有什么发现了吗？

text: Have you found out anything yet?
zh: 你有什么发现了吗？

text: Were you able to decipher the tome?
zh: 你破译出那本典籍了吗？

text: Were you able to decipher the tome?
zh: 你破译出那本典籍了吗？

text: Did you find out what's written in the tome?
zh: 你弄清楚典籍里写的是什么了吗？

text: See you.
zh: 回头见。

text: These volumes are unlike any others you’ll find.
zh: 这些藏书与你在别处所见的截然不同。

text: The works were collected by our brothers here at the Academy from all over the world.
zh: 这些著作是学院的同门从世界各地搜集而来的。

text: Some of these works, however, originate from the pens of our own magicians.
zh: 不过，其中一些著作出自我们自己的法师笔下。

text: Many of us specialize in a particular domain, which we study with dedication. The results of our studies are usually preserved in written form.
zh: 我们许多人都专精于某个特定的领域，潜心钻研。研究的成果通常会以文字的形式保存下来。

text: I am the keeper of knowledge here at the Academy.
zh: 我是学院的知识守护者。

text: My duty is to catalog the various works here and ensure their preservation.
zh: 我的职责是为馆中的各类著作编目，并确保它们妥善保存。

text: I also study old, long-destroyed writings that are scattered throughout the world and try to restore them.
zh: 我还研究散落于世界各地、久已损毁的古老文献，并设法将其修复。

text: The magicians often find #:torn pages:#, which they bring me in exchange for spellbooks or other works.
zh: 法师们时常会找到#:残页:#，他们会把残页带来给我，换取法术书或其他著作。

text: I am well aware of that.
zh: 这件事我很清楚。

text: Unfortunately, we do not know who stole this dangerous work or what the thief intends to do with it.
zh: 遗憾的是，我们不知道是谁偷走了这部危险的著作，也不知道窃贼打算用它做什么。

text: What is the book about?
zh: 那本书讲的是什么？

text: That's all.
zh: 就这些。

text: If you have any information regarding the book's whereabouts, please speak to Warak.
zh: 如果你有任何关于那本书下落的消息，请告诉瓦拉克。

text: Take care!
zh: 保重！

text: The Arcanum Sanguis is about other worlds and dangerous rituals.
zh: 血之秘典讲述的是其他世界与危险的仪式。

text: However, I am not allowed to tell you any more details about it.
zh: 不过，更多的细节我无权告诉你。

text:
A tome?
Let me see.
zh:
一本典籍？
让我看看。

text:
An astonishing work!
Even though I can't say how old the tome is, it's obvious that it defies time.
zh:
一部惊人的著作！
虽然我说不出这本典籍的年代，但它显然经受住了时间的考验。

text: The pages themselves are largely intact, as is the thread binding that holds them together. However, we should still handle the tome with care.
zh: 书页本身大体完好，装订书页的线绳也是如此。不过，我们仍应小心对待这本典籍。

text: This writing is strange, though. I've never seen symbols like this before.
zh: 只是这上面的文字很奇怪。我从未见过这样的符号。

text: Where did you find this tome?
zh: 你是在哪里找到这本典籍的？

text: Inside ruins near the capital.
zh: 在王都附近的遗迹里。

text:
Interesting.
This means that the ruins are far older than we first thought.
zh:
有意思。
这说明那处遗迹远比我们最初以为的古老。

text:
If you don't mind, I'd like to keep this tome and study it.
Maybe, I'll be able to decipher the text and its secrets.
zh:
如果你不介意，我想留下这本典籍加以研究。
或许，我能破译出其中的文字和它隐藏的秘密。

text:
Great!
Come back later when I have checked it more thoroughly.
zh:
太好了！
等我仔细检查过后，你再回来吧。

text: Sounds good. Keep the tome.
zh: 听起来不错。典籍就交给你了。

text: I still need the tome.
zh: 我还需要这本典籍。

text:
Alright.
You'll find me here if you change your mind.
zh:
好吧。
改变主意的话，随时来这里找我。

text: Hmm... not yet.
zh: 唔……还没有。

text: Well, I've been able to identify similar patterns, but haven't found any concrete meaning behind them yet.
zh: 嗯，我已经辨认出一些相似的规律，但还没有找到它们背后的确切含义。

text:
It seems I need knowledge of a language somewhere between that of the tome and our own.
A kind of linguistic link.
zh:
看来我需要一门介于典籍文字与我们语言之间的语言知识。
一种语言上的桥梁。

text: How about this book? (Give the mysterious book)
zh: 这本书怎么样？（交出神秘之书）

text: If I find anything, I'll bring it to you.
zh: 如果我找到什么，就给你带来。

text: What's this?
zh: 这是什么？

text:
Certainly!
That would be a great help to us!
zh:
当然！
那可帮了我们大忙！

text:
That could be it!
I need to borrow the book for a while.
zh:
也许就是它！
这本书我得借用一段时间。

text: Come back later!
zh: 过些时候再来吧！

text: Yes, the book actually served as a linguistic link and made it possible to decipher this forgotten language from the tome.
zh: 是的，那本书确实起到了语言桥梁的作用，让我们得以破译典籍中这门被遗忘的语言。

text: Here is your book.
zh: 这是你的书。

text:
If you'd like, I can lend you my notes, which you can also use to decipher the forgotten language.
However, I do have a favor to ask of you.
zh:
如果你愿意，我可以把我的笔记借给你，你也可以用它来破译那门被遗忘的语言。
不过，我有件事想拜托你。

text: What do you want?
zh: 你想要什么？

text: I'll take the notes.
zh: 我收下笔记。

text:
Take my notes back to where you took the tome.
If you find any more of these texts, I will reward you accordingly.
zh:
带上我的笔记，回到你取得典籍的地方去。
如果你能找到更多这样的文本，我会给你相应的报酬。

text: Take them.
zh: 拿去吧。

text: I was able to translate most of what was written in the tome.
zh: 典籍里写的内容，我大部分都翻译出来了。

text:
The text describes a city called #:Varethraen:# on a large continent, protected by several watchtowers.
Each tower carried a bell. Presumably for communication or defense.
zh:
文中描述了一座名为#:瓦雷斯兰:#的城市，坐落在一片广袤的大陆上，由数座瞭望塔守护。
每座塔上都悬有一口钟。想必是用于通讯或防御。

text: One of the towers was special. It led directly to a sanctuary in the heart of the city. The access was locked and required four keys, which were entrusted to the bell keepers.
zh: 其中一座塔与众不同。它直通城市中心的一处圣所。入口被封锁着，需要四把钥匙才能打开，而钥匙分别托付给了各位守钟人。

text: From what I've read, each tower was assigned a bell keeper. It stands to reason that this tome belonged to one of these keepers.
zh: 据我所读，每座塔都配有一位守钟人。可以推断，这本典籍正是其中一位守钟人的遗物。
